name: Chaos Crew

features.name: Multiplier wilds
features.description: Wilds land with multipliers that are added together on a winning line.

features.name: Sticky wild free spins
features.description: The top bonus keeps wilds in place and increases their multiplier each time a new wild lands.

review:
One of Hacksaw's early hits, and the game that set the studio's template: a compact 5x5 grid, multiplier wilds and a free spins round where wilds stick and can snowball.

The punk-style art still looks distinctive years later. It's less varied than Wanted Dead or a Wild, but much easier to understand, which makes it a great first Hacksaw game to try. Very high volatility, 10,000x max and 96.3% RTP.
cons: Bonus often ends without building up
